scope: Six vocational domain component families and all 22 configured variants; structural states, 320px and dedicated behavior assertions. No real backend or full browser certification.

checks.name: All six empty components and 22 configurable variants mount without caller mutation
Every scenario and readonly/disabled/loading/failed/forbidden/empty state fits 320px
Audience mixed selection deduplicates class members and protects disabled people
Audience directory refresh preserves confirmed snapshot and flags stale IDs
Audience single mode and organization scope constrain actual selection
Audience failure and reset retain draft until explicit discard confirmation
Curriculum totals aggregate only leaves and enforce course mode, hours and step
Curriculum editing preserves order, supports moves and objective associations
Curriculum add/delete protects assigned parent hours, depth and locked descendants
Curriculum author drafts reset both structure and input values after confirmation
Tasks display overdue separately and cannot bypass prerequisites or required checklist
Tasks teacher publication waits for acknowledgement and failure keeps the draft
Tasks filters and views use the current records; no automatic completion
Question sheet supports five answer shapes including boolean false and empty fill detection
Question sheet draft failure retains answers and blocks duplicate submit
Question sheet single navigation, marking and partial submission require explicit confirmation
Student DOM config excludes unreleased reference answers and teacher-only feedback
Question deadline locks new answers without inventing an automatic submission
Question author changes question type/structure, and total-score validation is real
Submission requires evidence and validates real File type/count/size, preserving references
Submission creates immutable versions only after confirmation; rejected submit preserves draft
Submission withdrawal keeps history and returned versions can be resubmitted
Teacher return requires a reason and past submission versions cannot be graded
Teacher rubric integration calculates final score and commits only the current confirmed version
Submission zero scores remain zero, unpublished scores stay unavailable, and no attempt means no grade
Rubric weighting distinguishes unscored, zero and not-applicable and rejects invalid numbers
Rubric points method renormalizes explicitly excluded dimensions
Rubric author validates weight totals and preserves independent confirmation baseline
All six readonly/disabled components prevent business mutations
Event-mode acknowledgement matches request ID; cancellation and late callbacks cannot overwrite drafts
Loader failure preserves drafts, retry works, and stale loads cannot replace current data
Forbidden states remove rendered business content and destroy closes dialogs and cancels operations
Chinese composition preserves the last committed answer until input is complete
Task prerequisites block start and clearing stale audience references can recover
Question author can add a real boolean question using ordinary answer controls
Rubric author can add and remove ordinary level rows with score validation
Runtime readonly transitions cancel open editors before they can mutate data
Teacher final score follows the confirmed rubric when override is not allowed
Composition cannot submit a stale question draft before its final value is committed
